author: Madmoney
text:
Didn't do much trading today, more of a study day.

Redsword11 and IF (and all the successful traders here) a big thank you. I have been trading fairly successfully even before this, but with a lot more stress, now I have to make a full transition to discontinue my old trading methods and perfect this method.

The best thing for new trader is to find this site, as they are uncontaminated with all the rubbish that is easily accessible on the web. If you are a bit of a seasoned trader and you come to this site it will be harder to grasp these concepts, also you have to have a bit of humility to unlearn what you already think you know.

For people struggling, READ/STUDY the educational section, analyse other successful trader journals (all of them), start your own journal/homework and be open to criticism.

You will hit walls but keep going you will soon see the truth!
